invariants.rationale: The count starts at 1 (for self), and only increases by recursing into child nodes, so result is always at least 1.
If the node is not expanded, the result is 1. Otherwise, the result is greater than or equal to 1, so at exit, result is either 1 or greater.
This expresses that either the minimal return (collapsed/not expanded) is 1, or more if children are expanded.
